notes.title: Steam Prison - Beyond the Steam Now Available!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003020/Steam_Prison_Beyond_the_Steam/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017084/8c8ce2beda03f8f79f9d4907190e415e57039fcf.png[/img][/url]

This third entry to the world of Steam Prison presents two new tales for our heroine, Cyrus. A New Theory, presents a new, alternative take on the original tale where Sachsen is the one to meet Cyrus instead of Ines, leading to her involvement with the HOUNDS and a new romantic ending with fan-favorite Sachsen.

The Cainabel Story follows the Grand Ending of the original Steam Prison as Cyrus and her party of handsome men journey to the new desert kingdom of Cainabel, where Cyrus meets with either the younger king, Jevite - a friendly, capable young man who burns hot like the sun as he investigates the former king's passing, or the older king, Jereme - a stoic beacon for his people, as introspective as the moon while he tries to secure his kingdom's future.

What will Cyrus learn from the handsome kings of Cainabel? Can she truly help guide them and their nation toward a better future? And what about her own future? Surely the mysteries and strange experiences of Cainable will light her way...

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]v1.0.2[/h3]

[list]
[*]Missing save icons for the picturebook scenes added.
[*]Fixed a save icon for one of the later chapters displaying the wrong title.
[*]Creating a save in between dialogue boxes could sometimes result in the game throwing an error when trying to load the save. Added safeguards to prevent the menu from being opened when it's not safe to do so.
[/list]

[h3]v1.0.1[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed missing BGM on the main menu.
[*]Fixed incorrect BGM looping in certain scenarios.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

Attempting to open the save menu on systems with an AMD GPU and outdated graphics drivers causes the game to crash for some users. We are still looking into this issue, but updating drivers seems to fix the crash in reported cases.

If you are experiencing this issue and updating your drivers does not resolve it, please contact us at support@mangagamer.com

notes.title: Sona-Nyl of the Violet Shadows - Refrain Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2656690/SonaNyl_of_the_Violet_Shadows_Refrain/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017084/205ab3719b3abbf8107a05aea9949d7912d37935.png[/img][/url]

Explore the warped ruins of a steampunk New York City in this dramatic tale of mystery, discovery, and loss. 

The fifth entry in Liarsoft's Steampunk Series is a mysterious fairy-tale in which fantasy and reality intertwine. The story unfolds from the perspectives of two women: one who travels through the ruins of Engine City New York, destroyed in an unexplained disaster some years before; and one who finds herself in an underground world with a purple sky, where the "vanished" city still stands.

The central focus of the tale is Lily, a girl devoid of memories who sets off through the bizarrely transformed "Underground New York." Driven by her determination to reach the "ends of the sky," she travels through this dangerous world accompanied by an enigmatic young man known as A. In the course of her long and difficult journey, they meet many of the city's inhabitants, and fend off the attacks of strange and terrifying monsters.

What lies at the end of the road Lily travels? How is she connected to the woman exploring the ruins on the surface? And why was New York destroyed? In the course of their journeys, many mysteries will be unraveled...

For more information on Sona-nyl of the Violet Shadows, as well as other titles from MangaGamer, be sure to join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/5vbgyU6vxG]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MangaGamer]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/MangaGamerOfficial/]Facebook[/url].
